description: Wire everything together: OverviewPanel, ResultsPanel, the main app/trusttrace/page.tsx, and documentation updates. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (all components and client.ts must exist). Final step is full build verification and doc updates.
steps: Create components/trusttrace/OverviewPanel.tsx. Mark 'use client'. Import getHealth, HealthResponse from lib/trusttrace/client.ts. Import RunStatus, Evaluation, AgentMode from lib/trusttrace/models.ts. Import StatusBadge. Define local type RecentRunEntry: { run_id: string; scenario_id: string; agent_mode: AgentMode; protection_enabled: boolean; status: RunStatus; evaluation: Evaluation | null; created_at: string }. Props: { onStartRun: () => void; recentRuns: RecentRunEntry[] }. State: health (HealthResponse|null), healthLoading (bool, default true), healthError (string|null). useEffect on mount: call getHealth(), set health, set healthLoading=false. On error set healthError. Render: (1) Hero header: large text 'DevSentinel TrustTrace' with gradient (from-cyan-400 to-violet-400 via bg-clip-text), tagline 'Observe the attempt. Enforce the boundary. Prove the outcome.' in gray-400. (2) Health card (mica-strong rounded-xl p-4): loading skeleton or healthError red text or health data: status pill, module, version, capabilities (scripted + ollama boolean pills). Ollama sub-row: reachable (teal if true, red if false), model name, error message if present. (3) Available scenarios note: 'Run repo-injection (attack scenario) or benign-task (baseline).' (4) Recent runs section: if recentRuns.length === 0 show empty state 'No runs yet.'. If runs exist: table with columns Run ID (font-mono text-xs w-32 truncated) | Scenario | Mode | Protection | Status | Verdict | Started. Status and Verdict use StatusBadge. Protection: Lock icon (teal) or Unlock icon (red). (5) CTA button at bottom: <button onClick={onStartRun} className='px-6 py-3 bg-brand-primary hover:bg-brand-primary/80 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2'><PlayCircle className='h-5 w-5' /> Start a Run</button>.

Create components/trusttrace/ResultsPanel.tsx. Mark 'use client'. Import RunStatus, Evaluation, AgentMode, Verdict from lib/trusttrace/models.ts. Import StatusBadge. Define local type RecentRunEntry matching OverviewPanel's definition: { run_id: string; scenario_id: string; agent_mode: AgentMode; protection_enabled: boolean; status: RunStatus; evaluation: Evaluation | null; created_at: string }. Props: { runs: RecentRunEntry[] }. Render: (1) Filter completedRuns = runs.filter(r => r.status === 'completed' && r.evaluation !== null). If completedRuns.length === 0: empty state glass-panel card 'No completed runs yet. Start a run to see results.' (2) For each completed run: result card (mica-strong rounded-xl p-4 mb-3): large StatusBadge for verdict, scenario ID, agent mode badge, protection icon, checks summary line (e.g. '3 / 5 checks passed' — compute from evaluation.checks). evaluation.reasoning text truncated to 3 lines with a 'Show more' toggle (useState per-card or a single expandedId state). (3) Comparison section: group completedRuns by scenario_id. For each scenario that has BOTH a protection_enabled=true AND protection_enabled=false completed run: render a two-column comparison card. Left column header 'Protected' with teal border-t; right column header 'Unprotected' with red border-t. Each column: verdict badge, policy_denied boolean, forbidden_operation_occurred boolean. Never show the comparison card if only one side exists. Never invent percentages. (4) Failed/inconclusive runs: show in a separate subsection 'Inconclusive / Failed Runs' with amber/red styling.

Create app/trusttrace/page.tsx. Mark 'use client'. Import OverviewPanel, RunConfigForm, RunWorkspace, ResultsPanel, ReportView from their component paths. Import RunStatus, Evaluation, AgentMode from lib/trusttrace/models.ts. Define local type RecentRunEntry: { run_id: string; scenario_id: string; agent_mode: AgentMode; protection_enabled: boolean; status: RunStatus; evaluation: Evaluation | null; created_at: string }. State: activeTab ('overview'|'run'|'workspace'|'results'|'report', default 'overview'), currentRunId (string|null, default null), currentRunCompleted (boolean, default false), completedRuns (RecentRunEntry[], default []). handleRunCreated(runId: string): setCurrentRunId(runId); setCurrentRunCompleted(false); setActiveTab('workspace'). handleRunCompleted(run: RecentRunEntry): setCompletedRuns(prev => [run, ...prev]); setCurrentRunCompleted(run.status === 'completed'). Tab definitions: const tabs = [{ id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', disabled: false }, { id: 'run', label: 'Run', disabled: false }, { id: 'workspace', label: 'Workspace', disabled: currentRunId === null }, { id: 'results', label: 'Results', disabled: false }, { id: 'report', label: 'Report', disabled: currentRunId === null || !currentRunCompleted }]. Tab bar:
. Each tab: . Page header above tab bar:

DevSentinel TrustTrace

Observe the attempt. Enforce the boundary. Prove the outcome.

. Tab panel rendering using a switch or conditional: overview -> setActiveTab('run')} recentRuns={completedRuns} />; run -> ; workspace -> currentRunId ? { setCurrentRunId(null); setCurrentRunCompleted(false); setActiveTab('run'); }} onCompleted={handleRunCompleted} /> :
No active run. Go to Run tab to start one.
; results -> ; report -> currentRunId ? :
No run selected.

Run full verification suite: npx vitest run (expect 17/17), npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck (expect 0 errors), npm run build (expect exit 0). Fix any TypeScript errors found. Do not modify working backend files to fix frontend TS errors — adjust only the new frontend files.

Update TRUSTTRACE-HANDOFF.md: append a new section '## 14. Frontend' documenting: route /trusttrace (no auth required), component tree (page -> tabs -> components), API client at lib/trusttrace/client.ts, tab structure, verdict color mapping, polling behavior (2s interval, 150s timeout), design tokens used. Update README.md TrustTrace section: add a row to the API Endpoints table if appropriate, add a 'Frontend' subsection under the TrustTrace section listing the /trusttrace route, how to access it (npm run dev then open http://localhost:3000/trusttrace), and that it requires no login.
acceptance_criteria: components/trusttrace/OverviewPanel.tsx fetches health on mount and renders health card, recent runs table, and CTA
components/trusttrace/ResultsPanel.tsx renders per-run result cards and comparison section only when both runs exist
app/trusttrace/page.tsx renders tab navigation with correct disabled states
Workspace tab becomes enabled after a run is started; Report tab becomes enabled after a run is completed
verification: npx vitest run — expect 17 passed (5 files)
npm run build — expect exit code 0
findings: COMPLETED. Created components/trusttrace/OverviewPanel.tsx (exports OverviewPanel + RecentRunEntry type; fetches getHealth on mount; renders gradient hero header, health card with status/capabilities/ollama sub-row, scenarios note, recent runs table with StatusBadge for status/verdict, Lock/Unlock icons for protection, CTA button). Created components/trusttrace/ResultsPanel.tsx (exports ResultsPanel + RecentRunEntry type; shows completed run cards with verdict StatusBadge, checks summary, expandable reasoning via toggle; comparison section only when BOTH protection_enabled=true AND protection_enabled=false runs exist for same scenario_id — two-column with teal/red border-t headers; separate Inconclusive/Failed section). Replaced app/trusttrace/page.tsx with tab-based orchestrator: 5 tabs (overview/run/workspace/results/report); Workspace disabled when currentRunId===null; Report disabled when currentRunId===null OR !currentRunCompleted; handleRunCreated→switches to workspace tab; handleRunCompleted→pushes to completedRuns and updates currentRunCompleted. RecentRunEntry type defined locally in page.tsx — structurally identical to OverviewPanel and ResultsPanel definitions. Updated TRUSTTRACE-HANDOFF.md with section '## 14. Frontend' covering route, component tree, API client, tab structure, verdict color mapping, polling behavior (2s/150s), design tokens, comparison condition. Updated README.md TrustTrace section with Frontend subsection (route /trusttrace, npm run dev URL, tab descriptions). Verification: 17/17 vitest pass, 0 tsc errors, npm run build exit 0 (/trusttrace built at 12.1 kB).
